runtime_contract.coverage_interpretation: Coverage applies only to an explicitly declared test payload and never to the real ISO standard.

packs.content_scope: Registered public ISO metadata and public high-level clause identifiers only; no normative statements or ISO controls.
packs.coverage_scope: No executable payload exists. Future test coverage may describe only the declared test payload, never ISO 9001:2015 coverage.
packs.readiness_blocker: Registered sources do not contain atomic obligations; creating them would synthesize protected ISO normative content.

packs.content_scope: Registered public ISO metadata only; no normative structure or statements are materialized as executable content.
packs.coverage_scope: No executable payload exists. Future test coverage may describe only the declared test payload, never ISO 9001:2026 coverage.
packs.readiness_blocker: Registered sources do not contain atomic obligations; creating them would synthesize protected ISO normative content.

packs.content_scope: Registered public ISO metadata and high-level structure only. ISO27001Toolkit.zip is not mounted and no toolkit material was copied.
packs.coverage_scope: No executable payload exists. Future toolkit-derived test artifacts must retain toolkit provenance and cannot count as ISO normative coverage.
packs.readiness_blocker: Atomic normative obligations are unavailable and the supporting toolkit is not mounted in the visible filesystem.
